applyGrant.title: Apply for Grant
applyGrant.tierRequired: You need to be at least Tier 2 to apply for a grant.
applyGrant.mustBeTier2: You must be Tier 2 to apply for a grant.
applyGrant.heroDesc: This takes less than a minute and ensures you fully understand the nature of what you're applying for.
applyGrant.declarationP1: Seedin administers authorized grant programs under a public-private initiative designed to accelerate economic mobility, reduce household debt, and expand access to capital for everyday people. The funds disbursed through this program are grants — not loans.
applyGrant.declarationP2: A grant is a direct financial award made to an eligible individual or household with no obligation of repayment, no interest, no equity transfer, and no conditions attached to the money once disbursed. You will never be asked to pay this money back — not in part, not in full, not under any circumstance.
applyGrant.declarationP3: This is categorically different from a personal loan, a payday advance, a business line of credit, or any form of debt instrument. Once the money is in your account, it is entirely and permanently yours.
applyGrant.declarationP4: Grant funds are sourced from designated programme allocations and are disbursed directly into the bank account you provide during this application. Disbursement typically occurs within 14 business days of approval.
applyGrant.declarationNotice: Important notice: Submitting false or misleading information is a serious offence and may result in disqualification, demand for return of funds, or civil liability.
applyGrant.loanItem4: No debt added to your record
applyGrant.ackLabel: I have read and understood the grant declaration above. I confirm that I understand this is a grant and not a loan, that no repayment will ever be required, and that I am applying with truthful and accurate information.
applyGrant.checkBoxFirst: Please check the box above to continue.

withdrawal.upgradeTier3Desc: Tier 3 membership unlocks full withdrawal access and unlimited grant disbursements.
withdrawal.tier3BenefitsDesc: Full access to withdraw funds, apply for unlimited grants, and priority processing.
withdrawal.whatsRequiredDesc: To upgrade to Tier 3, you must complete the following:
withdrawal.req2: Provide proof of bank account for disbursement
withdrawal.req3: Complete the live video verification session
withdrawal.upgradeReviewNote: Upgrades are manually reviewed. Processing typically takes 24–48 hours.
withdrawal.requestDesc: Withdrawals are reviewed and transferred within 24–72 hours of approval.
withdrawal.verifiedAccount: This is your verified withdrawal account
withdrawal.feeNote: A 3% admin processing fee covers wire transfer and compliance costs. No other charges apply. After submission, an admin will review your request. Funds typically transfer within 24–72 hours.
withdrawal.confirmDesc: Your withdrawal request has been received and is being processed by our team. The approved funds will be credited to your linked bank account within 24–72 hours.
withdrawal.nextStep3: Funds transfer to your linked bank account
withdrawal.confirmNote: Additional verification may be requested, which could extend processing time. You'll be notified via email if we need more information.

connectEmail.title: Account Protection
connectEmail.desc: Link your email for faster verification and secure correspondence.
connectEmail.heroDesc: Members who link a verified inbox move through review faster and carry a stronger, harder-to-compromise account. It takes under a minute, and you stay in complete control.
connectEmail.benefit1Body: Beyond your password and sign-in code, a verified inbox lets us confirm it's really you before any balance, tier or withdrawal change is processed.
connectEmail.benefit2Body: Applications from members with a confirmed inbox skip a manual identity step, which typically shortens review time considerably.
connectEmail.benefit3Body: Grant approvals, verification links and disbursement notices reach you reliably — even if you're away from the app.
connectEmail.privacyNote: Seedin never sees or stores your email password. Provider sign-in happens entirely on Google's or Microsoft's own website, and you can disconnect at any time from this page.
connectEmail.disconnectFailed: Couldn't disconnect right now. Please try again.
connectEmail.providerTitle: Sign in with your email provider
connectEmail.providerDesc: You'll be taken to the provider's own secure sign-in page. Seedin never sees your password.
connectEmail.popupBlocked: Please allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
connectEmail.otherDesc: Using Yahoo, iCloud, AOL or a work address? We'll email you a 6-digit code to confirm the inbox is yours. No password required.

connectEmail.codeExpiry: Enter the code sent to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.

upgradeTier.subheading: Unlock grant applications up to $15,000. Your information is encrypted end-to-end and used only for federal identity verification.
upgradeTier.govIdDesc: Upload a clear photo of the front and back of your Driver's License or State ID.
upgradeTier.selfieDesc: Take a selfie of yourself holding your ID or Driver's License next to your face.
upgradeTier.noSsnCard: I don't have a physical SSN card.
upgradeTier.noSsnCardDesc: Submit without the card image. Verification may take longer and a reviewer may contact you for an alternative document.
upgradeTier.successDesc: Your Tier 2 upgrade is now pending review. Our verification team is reviewing your documents.
upgradeTier.successBody: Our team will reach out to you shortly with a secure link to complete the final live verification required for Tier 2. Keep an eye on your notifications and email inbox.
upgradeTier.deviceRequirementDesc: The final verification can only be completed on a laptop, desktop computer, tablet or iPad with a working webcam. Mobile phones are not allowed and the session will not open on a phone.

updateTier3.title: Upgrade to Tier 3
updateTier3.introDesc: Upgrade to Tier 3 and apply for unlimited grant amounts. Link your bank account securely to get started.
updateTier3.heroDesc: Upgrade to Tier 3 and apply for unlimited grant amounts. Link your bank account securely to get started.
updateTier3.whyLinkDesc: Your bank account is required for secure fund transfers. We use bank-level encryption to protect your information. Your account details are never stored directly on our servers. All withdrawals go exclusively to this verified account — prepaid cards and third-party accounts are not supported.
updateTier3.selectBankDesc: Search or choose from the list below
updateTier3.bankNotFoundDesc: We couldn't find "{{bank}}" in our list. You can still proceed.
updateTier3.noBanksHint: Try typing your bank name in full

updateTier3.secureConnection: Secure, encrypted connection — your credentials are protected

updateTier3.otpDesc: Confirm it's you before we continue
updateTier3.otpSentNotice: An OTP has been sent to your registered email or phone number on file with {{bank}}.
updateTier3.twoStepDesc: Confirm it's you before we continue
updateTier3.otpSent: An OTP has been sent to your registered email or phone number on file with {{bank}}.
updateTier3.processingSubtitle: Your account verification is being processed
updateTier3.processingDesc: Your account verification is being processed
updateTier3.processingBody: Thank you for upgrading to Tier 3. Your account has been successfully submitted for verification. Our review team is currently processing your request with careful attention to security and compliance. This process typically takes 24 hours, though it may require additional time depending on verification requirements. You will receive an email notification as soon as your upgrade is approved, at which point you'll have immediate access to unlimited grant applications and withdrawal capabilities. We appreciate your patience and recommend checking your email regularly for updates.
updateTier3.nextStep1: Our review team verifies your credentials and bank information
updateTier3.nextStep2: We conduct security and compliance checks (24 hours typical)
updateTier3.nextStep3: You'll receive an email confirmation once approved
updateTier3.nextStep4: Full Tier 3 access activated immediately upon approval
